title: Free trial welcome
description: Welcome new members to their free trial pass with first-visit tips. Welcome WhatsApp template for gyms and studios. Free to copy and edit.
notes: Tell them what to bring and how to book their first class. Mention expiry of the trial.

body.text: Welcome to Acme Fitness, {{first_name}}! Your free {{days}}-day pass is active. Book your first class and bring a water bottle.
